blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The police arrested six individuals during an anti-illegal gambling operation in Narvacan town Sunday afternoon. Personnel of the Narvacan Municipal Police Station conducted the operation at about 4:50 p.m. The suspects were allegedly caught playing card games with bets on two tables. Seized from the arrested suspects were two sets of playing cards and a total of P4,516 in bets. The Narvacan police urged residents to refrain from engaging in illegal gambling and to report such activities to authorities. /gsg...
